description: Instagram comment keywords (docs/plans/text-advisor/09-social.md § Inbox, SP-9; TA-S6). A comment whose first word (after any @mentions, emoji and punctuation; case and accents ignored) is one of a keyword's words gets one private reply (Meta allows exactly one per comment): the keyword's string from catalog/advisor/strings.json in the word's language, with the guide link and the text-us link. `guide` is a link placeholder body for server/advisor/links.ts: {port} is a port named in the comment, else the region default's first port; {species} a species named in the comment, else `species_default`. Words are lower case without accents and unique across keywords. server/advisor/social/inbox.ts reads this file; tests/test_advisor_instagram.mjs checks it.
